text:
deploy-bot: Deploy started: release v1.19.2 -> prod (change window 02:00-04:00 UTC). Feature flag 'ml_rewrite' is currently OFF. Canary cohort deployed to 1%. Planned ramp: 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% (30m). Reply with +1 to proceed or :warning: to hold.
sam: +1 to start but watching telemetry — small cache latency blip in canary at 02:10. Holding any larger ramp until we confirm it's transient. @anya can you eyeball logs?
anya: looking now — I see a burst of 500s from model-router-2 around 02:11. Could be NFS/KV eviction. Tailing logs: ```
2026-03-21T02:10:58Z model-router-2 ERROR 500 GET /v1/gen payload...
2026-03-21T02:11:03Z kv-cache WARN eviction spike: 87%
2026-03-21T02:11:09Z model-router-2 ERROR timeout to model-host-7
```
marta: recommend we PAUSE the global ramp and PIN routing for the affected cohort to v1.19.1 while ops investigates. We should also record a note in release notes.
lee: +1 to pause. Proposal: keep US ramp paused at 1%? Actually run US-only slow ramp if telemetry looks good; freeze EU (where errors seen). Can we do region-specific weighting?
oncall: @deploy-bot please halt ramp and set EU weight to 0% for ml_rewrite. Put an ops hold point in the deploy.
deploy-bot: Action: ml_rewrite -> set 0% in prod-eu. Canary kept at 1% in prod-us. Routing pin applied: model-service pinned to v1.19.1 for shard eu-west-1. To rollback routing: `/deploy rollback routing model-service v1.19.1` (operator-only).
sam: smoke tests passing in us-west, but agree keep global ramp paused and EU pinned. Marta, can you open an issue with timeline + logs?
marta: opened GH #4123: "ml_rewrite: transient model-router errors in EU during v1.19.2 canary". Added release-note draft line: "Paused ml_rewrite ramp due to transient model-router errors in EU; routing pinned to v1.19.1 for affected shards."
anya: ops is hotpatching kv-cache config to reduce eviction pressure. If stable in 10m, propose a conservative US-only ramp to 5% (1% -> 5%).
lee: agree. I'll execute US-only ramp script if we get green after 10m: `./ops/ramp_ff.sh ml_rewrite --region us --to 5 --steps 1,5 --wait 600`
deploy-bot: Scheduled US ramp: 1% -> 5% over 10m. Next automated check-in at +12m. Monitoring hooks enabled. :eyes:
oncall: monitoring dashboards active. If error rate > 1.5% or latency > 200ms in any region, auto-rollback will trigger and we'll pin back to v1.19.1. I'll stand by.
sam: thanks; we'll keep this thread live for final release-note wording and postmortem details. If all stable in US, we'll update release notes to reflect staged ramp; otherwise we'll capture rollback timeline. :thumbsup:
